description: Mark that the worker is on the way to a visit when they tell their agent, for example on my way, there by 2. eta is that time in their words and can be left out. A worker may call this only for a visit they are assigned to. The owner or office may call it for any visit in the shop. When on the way notices are on, the customer gets a text and an email. Text is the main one. The email goes whenever the customer has an email address, even if the text is blocked, refused, or does not go through. When arrival notices are also on, the message includes the time the worker gave. A repeat call does not send again.

eta.description: A time the worker says, for example there by 2, 2:30 PM, or 20 minutes. Leave it out when they do not give a time.

name: visit_on_my_way

customer_notice.description: queued: a customer notice was queued. off: the shop setting is off, so nothing was queued. already: this visit was already in this state, so nothing was sent again.

repeated.description: True when the visit was already in this state. A repeat call does not send the notice again and does not change the arrival time.
